newsitem.title: USA: Premier sees revs, earns below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Premier sees revs, earns below estimates.

text.p: Premier Research Worldwide Ltd said Tuesday revenues and earnings for the second quarter and 1997 overall would fall short of analysts' estimates.

President and chief executive Dr Joel Morganroth said in a statement that net revenues for the second quarter were expected to be substantially less than net revenues of $4.3 million for the second quarter of 1996.

"Due to ... lower-than-expected new contract signings and contract delays ... the company expects that while 1997 net revenues may exceed the prior year, revenues and earnings are likely to fall short of analysts' estimates for the quarter and the year."
Morganroth said expenses for the second quarter were expected to increase from the prior period as the clinical research company expanded its personnel and infrastructure.
"Second quarter results will reflect both sponsor-related delays under certain clinical research contracts and lower- than-expected new contract signings," he said.
